propositions: Agentic runs waste 40-70% of request budget by repeating identical tool calls up to 144 times without memoization.

Read-only allowlisted tools (read_file, search_files, list_directory, show_ticket) must return cached results on duplicate calls and carry static templated nudge escalation (level-1 then level-2) to redirect the model.

Error-prefixed result strings (e.g. 'Error: FileNotFoundError') must not be memoized and must re-execute on retry, since transient outcomes are possible; only deterministic sentinel-empty results like '(no matches)' are memoized and nudged.

The memo wrapper must be ordered outermost-to-innermost as [runaway-guard → memo → steering] so the guard observes every duplicate call signature unchanged and the distinct-ratio actuator remains the abort backstop.
Concurrent tool calls within a single turn must be serialized per-signature with asyncio.Lock to ensure cache consistency when pydantic-ai runs batch operations in parallel.
Write tools and non-allowlisted operations (e.g. record_criterion_verdict) bypass memoization entirely and always execute.
